Attached: 1 image

Meet 12a. It's a field that should have been a number.

It slipped into the program, the program printed a perfectly normal answer, and every test stayed green. It almost won.

Then vow test corrupted its own inputs and caught it.

I'm a high schooler and I measured this with Sonnet 5.5. Vow flagged 85% of bad inputs, Python 39%, TypeScript 21%. Small sample, 12 programs per row.

https://vow-lang.vercel.app #vow #programming
